 State (Nct Of Delhi)

Respo  FOR ADMISSION  IA No. 296559/2025 - EX-PARTE STAY  IA No. 296560/2025 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.
 Date : 05-12-2025
This matter was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIPUL M. PANCHOLI

For Petitioner(s) :
 Mr. Lave Kumar Sharma, Adv.
 Mr. Agam Sharma, AOR  For Respondent(s) :
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Learned counsel for the petitioner, at the outset submited that the petitioner had filed transfer in 664/2022 for transfer of Criminal Case filed by the respondent under Domestice Violence Act for transfer of the said case from Metropolitan Magistrate (Mahila Court No.2), Central District Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi to Court of Competent jurisdiction at Arki, Tehsil Arki, District Solan,
Himachal Pradesh.

entities.text: Metropolitan Magistrate (Mahila Court No.2), Central District Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that this Court vide order dated 18.07.2023 allowed the said transfer petitioner.

It is further submitted that now the respondent/complainant- wife has filed FIR under Section 498A, 406 and 34 IPC against the present petitioner-husband which is now pending before the JMFC (Mahila Court)-02, Central District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi.

entities.text: JMFC (Mahila Court)-02, Central District, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He therefore, urged that he may be permitted to implead the wife as respondent no.2 in the present petition.
Permission as prayed for is granted.
In view of the above submission issue notice to the respondent returnable within four weeks.
